scope: Aggregation only of this M0.1 raw-data directory. No browser, physical test, resource change or historical PASS was used.

sourceVersions.firstCandidateDifference: Independent trigger cancellation cadence only; normal fixed-step movement and absolute fire deadlines unchanged
sourceVersions.probeRevisionNotes: Numeric movement/firing protocol remained m01-postphysics-v1. Background recovery v2/v3 and native engine pause were added separately. Route final revision only adds input-reset diagnostics and aborts stale pointers; earlier raw results retained.

versionGrouping.before: Port18769 / before-*; base commit from source-versions.json
versionGrouping.distinction: Candidate1 and final differ only in independent/multiple-trigger cancellation cadence, as recorded in source-versions.json. Ordinary fixed-step movement and absolute firing deadlines are unchanged. Results remain labeled by the tested candidate.

deduplication.rule: De-duplicate history entries by runId. Ignore top-level snapshot status as a verdict for earlier runs. Preserve every distinct run, including FAIL/INCOMPLETE; never prefer a passing retry.

formulas.actualFps: Original game.onUpdate count divided by measured wall-clock window, copied from each raw case; not HUD FPS or requested cap.
formulas.distanceError: projectedDistance - configuredSpeed * measured input duration; stored expectedDistance/projectedDistance are original rounded measurements.
formulas.distanceTolerance: 3% of expected distance + two actual fixed physics steps of travel.
formulas.longWindow: 0.4..0.65s windows after startup: measured <= configuredSpeed*(1.05 + physicsStepSeconds/windowSeconds). Upper bound alone does not verify minimum speed.
formulas.shotCountRate: shotCount / measured held seconds. A finite window includes its initial pulse; 11 events in about2s can still satisfy the declared ±1-shot rule.
formulas.eventFrequency: (eventCount-1)/(last event time-first event time). Before-build event times are observed after real avatar.step; after builds use actual shotEvents timestamps.
formulas.releaseLatency: Separate direct input, Avatar held and original HUD timings from the release sidecar. Zero means already clear in the event-return sample, not an invented ideal timestamp.
